Q: What is the cause of my error "Expected a 2-dimensional container but got <class 'pandas.core.series.Series'> instead." A:

I encountered the same issue running this code:

import pandas as pd
from sklearn import preprocessing

df.read_csv('dataset.csv')

enc = preprocessing.OneHotEncoder()
enc.fit(df.loc[:, 'Geography'])

It raises the same error. I solved simply converting the Series to a DataFrame:

# ...
enc.fit(pd.DataFrame(df.loc[:, 'Geography']))

In the same vein maybe the problem in your code could be solved modifying the model.fit() argument:

# ...
model.fit(pd.DataFrame(X_train), Y_train)

Other methods are listed in this answer.

Q: How to send message to unsaved number using Telegram API(Telethon) A:

First you need to make telethon aware of all the entities at least once: For this use:

dialogs = await client.get_dialogs()

After this get the entity represented by the mobile number using the command:

entity = await client.get_entity(<mobile_num>)

Now you can use the entity to send message

await client.send_message(entity, 'Hello, friend!')

For more info have a look at this : Telethon Entities
